notes.title: Work-in-Progress Content Preview: Defense Mode
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is BlueTale.[/p][p][/p][p]I should probably start by addressing the Sole Survivor mode I previously announced.[/p][p]Originally, this mode was conceived as a concept where you defeat an endless wave of enemies to gather experience points and grow.[/p][p][/p][p]Most of the feature development is now complete, but during the process of testing actual gameplay and balance, we encountered two difficult problems that are hard to resolve.[/p][olist][*][p]Due to the limitations of the TPS genre, deploying too many enemies at once made the difficulty excessively high. After reducing enemy numbers, the progression lacked the expected intensity.[/p][/*][*][p]Conversely, late-game battles were overly chaotic to handle without respite, making the continuous combat unsustainable.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]It felt ambiguous to keep developing this mode indefinitely without a clear end in sight, so I changed plans and decided to prioritize creating a Defense Mode that better fits the actual game flow.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975477/3524ce1394633272bb206a44e11fba7c40055cf3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The working title for the Defense mode is Outpost Defense. The objective is to eliminate waves of enemies arriving in rounds and defend the excavator from space pirates attempting to destroy the base.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975477/36339484826f2dec992722c45865247ef48e44e4.png"][/img][/p][p]In Outpost Defense Mode, new game rules and new enemies will appear![/p][p][/p][p]I'll continue to consistently share our development direction and thought process going forward.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 16.09.25 (Build 708) Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]Character-specific traits have been added.
Each character specializes in different areas such as survival, attack, defense, and supply.
These values and information can be viewed in the character selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The lobby now displays the character selection screen upon first entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where weapons like the VoltEdge Saw and Boom Box would emit operational sounds even when out of ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now rarely drop small ammo packs.
Small ammo packs replenish 20% of the current weapon's ammo and 10% of other weapons' ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]The ammo capacity of most Legendary weapons has been increased by approximately 10%.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 10.09.25 (Build 690) Update
notes.notes: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]Accuracy improvement during ADS now functions correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player's hands would appear empty when discarding a weapon mid-switch.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons equipped on DOGGIE will now display in teammates' status windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Coin colors have been changed for improved visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell weapons you currently possess at the store.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Content in Development[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975477/04466109d261fd4cb6b4e1f0471dccb3b9b6d9fc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Currently, patches are mainly focused on bug fixes and system improvements, so I felt it necessary to share the current WIP contents.[/p][/*][*][p]The mode currently in development is “Sole Survivor” mode. This mode involves defeating endless waves of enemies, gaining experience to grow stronger, and surviving for a limited time.[/p][/*][*][p]The core systems are all ready, but we're currently finding the right balance: if there are even slightly more enemies, the difficulty becomes too high, and if there are fewer, it doesn't feel like waves.[/p][/*][*][p]If you have any questions or ideas about this mode, please let us know anytime![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 04.09.25 (Build 677) Update
notes.notes: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]Enemy attack power has been slightly reduced on Normal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shotgun weapons fired in the wrong direction when using the “Multi-Trigger Interface” artifact.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hit detection would not occur properly when the projectile speed of the “Warglaive Caster” and “Disperser” was too fast.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an error would occur in the options window when a controller was not connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where an error could occur in the game mode selection window.[/p][/*][*][p]Power-up icons have been changed. The previous icons will be used for a new item called the Enhancement Device.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]If the game is launched with the controller inactive, the controller may not be recognized until the game is turned off and back on.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Furball Blitz! Early Access Begins!
notes.notes: [h2]Hello![/h2][p]The early access for Furball Blitz! has finally begun.[/p][p]This game is a casual shooting game based on a shoulder-view TPS, aiming to deliver intense gunfights with a variety of weapons and relics.[/p][p][/p][p]The current early access version includes a dungeon crawl roguelike mode called “Escort Mode.”[/p][p][/p][h2]Planned updates until official release[/h2][list][*][p]Wave-based defense mode[/p][/*][*][p]PvP modes such as Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of more weapons and relics[/p][/*][/list][p]and more are planned.[/p][p][/p][h2]We need your help[/h2][p]Furball Blitz! will actively incorporate user feedback through Early Access to continue improving the game.[/p][list][*][p]Which weapons were fun to use, and which ones would you like to see added?[/p][/*][*][p]Is the balance of each growth structure well-balanced?[/p][/*][*][p]Or, any opinions or ideas on improvements to the game, or features you'd like to see added (even modes!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]All feedback is appreciated.[/p][p]Any form of feedback is welcome![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: The second beta test has been completed!
notes.notes: [p]I conducted playtesting for longer than planned and received a lot of feedback![/p][p]I have applied almost all of the feedback I received during the playtesting period.[/p][p][/p][p]The following are the main changes made during the playtest:[/p][list][*][p]Overall difficulty and balance adjustments: The overall difficulty has been lowered.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty system added: A harder difficulty level has been added for those seeking a greater challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Branching point system added: The game has been changed from a pre-set map to a style where branching points continuously appear, allowing players to progress in the direction they choose.[/p][/*][*][p]New “Test Cell” node added: A new type of special room has been added to provide tension without combat.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]There are many other changes as well![/p][p]I would like to express my gratitude to everyone who participated and provided feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for the early access release![/p]
